newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VIRU RAND TO GET LISTING IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: VIRU RAND TO GET LISTING IN JUNE.

text.p: Balti Cresco said on Monday Estonia's fish factory Viru Rand is expected to get listed on the main list of the Tallinn bourse in the first half of June.
"When it gets listed, some of its existing shares will be sold on the bourse," Indrek Rahumaa, head of corporate finance, told Reuters.
The share capital of Viru Rand is 40 million kroons, which is mostly owned by management and several Estonian investment funds.
"The funds will sell some stake to add some liquidity," he added.
Viru Rand also plans to issue new shares in autumn to finance the construction of a new fish factory, Rahumaa said. The issue has not been approved yet, he added.
"The company faces big demand and it has good export potential," Rahumaa said.
Viru Rand turnover has grown from 190 million kroons in 1995 to 250 million kroons in 1996, and is estimated to grow to 325 million kroons this year.
It had a net profit of 6.6 million kroons in the first quarter of this year.
